g.text: Clinical reasoning and adaptive collaboration. MDAgents [1]
Memory. Environment and preference stores, procedural skills, session retrieval [23]
Tools. MCP, FHIR queries, DICOM interfaces and code execution [24]
Training. Experience extraction, verifiers and backbone updates. ExpeL [8]
Illustrative frameworks. Hermes [25] and AutoGen [26]. Clinician-directed workflows in
Context management (§3.1). Compression, cached prefixes and iteration budgets.
Persistent memory (§3.1). Files, databases, memory graphs and replacement.
Skill synthesis (§3.1). Trace2Skill [30], CoEvoSkills [31], SkillClaw [32], SkillRL [11]
Skill verification. Versioned artifacts, retained trajectories and held-out acceptance.
Candidate clinical workflow. Retrieval, synthesis, revision, consolidation and held-out
Tool integration (§3.2). MCP [24], FHIR, DICOM and composite imaging tools. MACRO [36]
Parallel collaboration (§3.2). Separate contexts, summary consolidation and shared
Routing and workflow organization (§3.2). Intent-aware MedAide [37] and Medical Data
Parameter updates. Diagnostic policies in DiagAgent [40] and expert-guided classifiers in
Verifiers and trajectory filtering. MedZERO [42], confidence-gated relabeling and SFT/DPO in
Training generators and recipes. CoEvolve [12], ECG-RSI [43] and ReVision3D [44]
Synthetic encounters. Agent Hospital [9]. Generation volume, clinical realism and learning on
Prompt engineering [5] and RadioRAG [6]. Retrieval, experience retention and
Clinical reasoning and decision-making (§4.1). MDAgents [1], Agent Hospital [9],
ClinicalAgents [10], DiagAgent [40], DoctorAgent-RL [46] and historical AI Clinician [45]
Medical image analysis and reporting (§4.2). MACRO [36], TissueLab [41],
R2GenGPT [48], Radiologist Copilot [49] and report translation [47]
Medical question answering and evidence retrieval (§4.3). RadioRAG [6], Almanac [51]
Retained artifacts, supervision and evaluation settings connect mechanisms to the three
Memory benefits. Retained content, model dependence, harmful transfer and
Component attribution. Changed and fixed components, joint updates and isolated
Generator comparisons. Matched learning conditions, accepted data, rejected
Independent testing. Held-out patients, monitoring-cohort reuse and the roles of human
Imaging evidence. Retrospective and benchmark studies; prospective adaptation
Feedback quality and error propagation. Retention checks, independent verifiers and
Retention, privacy and memory security. PHI, de-identification, access, deletion and
Transfer and degradation. Domain shift, retrieval, consolidation, rare knowledge and
Interpretability and clinical use. Evidence/version links, physician oversight and
Orchestration costs. Calls, latency, cached retrieval and update-generation or revision
Release governance. Update scope, clinical validation, change plans and
Experience transfer. Multimodal information, controlled institutional sharing and
Successive updates. Independent later-cycle tests, fixed-procedure controls, versions
Clinical consequences. Accuracy, diagnostic thinking, workflow and patient outcomes.
Longitudinal release. Follow-up, clinical errors, agent versions, provenance and responsible
